nativeReinvestigation.method: Existing rebuilt Release profile_answer_map, readonly immutable backup, no HTTP server. Preliminary load, one warmup handler, then three sequential actual handler calls. No product/source changes.
nativeReinvestigation.interpretation: This confirms the remaining shape fetch/decode and large-data handling costs. It is a new diagnostic run, not a before/after speed improvement or regression. SQLx can include setup/fetch/row conversion; residual includes Context conversion, body validation/assembly, scheduling, lock waits, unobserved work and cleanup. JSON encoding is inside rendering, and rendering is inside handler wall time. Each median is calculated separately.

sameTargetNormalBodyReferenceEstimate.scope: Byte-only encoding experiment: nonempty popup strings exactly equal to the same target normal body become a typed reference. No parts reinterpretation or string concatenation. Full shapes/normal bodies remain unchanged. Proposed version marker is estimation overhead, not an adopted protocol.

verifiedWholeNormalReconstructionEstimat.scope: Byte-only, not implementation. Replace a normal memo only after exact whole-string equality with a specified order of its existing free/managed strings; all other memos stay unchanged. No answer-boundary inference or parts rewrite. A future decoder must restore all canonical bodies before consumers and print capacity checks.

transportAnalysis.gzipScope: Diagnostic size only, not an HTTP implementation or CPU/speed result; decoded HTML and browser parsing remain full size.
transportAnalysis.scope: Current readonly immutable SQLite copy, aggregate strings/counts/bytes only. No raw data or individual identifiers/hashes are exported. Data shape matches previous counts and byte sizes; whole-section digest comparison additionally checks all values except generated as_of.

transportMethod: Existing non-eval bootstrap parser with Decimal/integer preservation checks all11section values against the previous native JSON snapshot, excluding only generated query.as_of. They match.
Measure original UTF8 bytes and the exact current json_encode_for_html string escaping; canonical ASCII fingerprint byte counts are not transmission sizes.
Compare each full normal body with its same-target free_text and managed_markdown in each fixed concatenation order. Equality is verified, never inferred from parts or answer position.

Simple whole-field aliasing yields no matches in this dataset. A global exact-string pool can save at most4,805,325bytes before any dictionary/reference overhead; it is lower priority than verified normal-body reconstruction.

priorities.change: Prototype verified same-target normal-body reconstruction in transport only
priorities.why: Full HTML remains72.6MB. This dataset has19,776 exact reconstruction matches; the byte-only estimate is47.94MB, saving24.66MB/33.97%. It may reduce transport and parsing work on PC/mobile while retaining all geometry and answer strings; runtime restoration has not been measured.
requiredDesign: Keep one authenticated native POST response and the same transaction/snapshot. Do not replace popup snapshots with later database fetches.

Server verifies the entire original string per target in a fixed known order, and encodes only when the escaped JSON becomes smaller. Preserve nonmatching, nonstring or missing memo values and all sync_required flags exactly. Compare borrowed slices without allocating an extra concatenation where possible. Do not alter stored parts, trim, normalize Unicode, insert newlines or infer answer boundaries.
Use an explicit version and a transport envelope that cannot collide with arbitrary GeoJSON properties or user strings; the47byte marker is only a sizing example.

Decoder accepts only fixed same-target references, own entries and string leaves. Reject missing/invalid/unknown references, cycles, alternate target paths and unsupported versions without publishing partial data.

Restore encoded memo/detail values to canonical strings and complete bootstrap before original validation, runtime, search, popup or ready notification. Remove transport-only metadata from canonical data. Publish/cache and remove source DOM only after complete success. Keep legacy bootstrap compatibility.
Print receives fully restored canonical snapshots; enforce the existing32MiB limit on reconstructed full content, never compressed/encoded bytes.
priorities.measure: Record exact wire bytes, server equality/encoding cost, browser JSON.parse plus restore time, loading-cleared and combined-ready, observed heap boundaries and fresh-Chrome private commit. Speed and memory are separate runs. Confirm all11canonical sections after decoding.
priorities.effectStatus: Data-size opportunity quantified. No new browser/native codec is implemented; no latency or memory savings are claimed.

sequence: Add fixed-label spans for popup target preparation, parts validation/free-text/managed assembly, Context construction, Tera mutex wait and escaping. Separate DB execution/fetch/GeoJSON conversion as available.

First compare borrowing popup body slices instead of owning copies. Then consider ownership-preserving Context construction or escaping only where measured. Do not treat the entire residual as removable.
Inspect repeated answer-scope query plans only after row conversion is distinguished. Do not add an index or replace snapshots with range fetch merely because shape SQLx time is large.
priorities.effectStatus: Specific per-step costs and savings are not yet isolated. Likely narrower than the full transport opportunity; fallback to isolated low-risk copy removal if transport reconstruction fails compatibility/memory checks.

validationPlan: Freeze the same readonly copy, query/as_of, target set, parent view and source revision. Run before/after sequentially with other builds/tests stopped.
For each independent candidate, measure frozen-HTML browser behavior and actual native/live behavior, PC/mobile each3trials. Record every trial and median; do not add overlapping spans.

Run memory separately with periodic/boundary samples plus fresh-Chrome after-GC private commit and JS heap. Private commit is resident-or-paged committed allocation; WorkingSet sum may duplicate shared pages; neither observed samples nor checkpoints prove instantaneous peak.

Validate exact normal/free/all-answer text, current geometry/name, owner/latest/as_of/filters, inherited view, authentication retry and stale responses, search/color/CSV, full canonical print snapshots and close-time iframe/runtime release.

Cover interleaved or repeated text, multiple/empty answers, ambiguous legacy bodies, missing stored parts, sync_required, marker and shape, CRLF/control characters, emoji/combining characters, script-breakout strings, own __proto__ keys, unsupported version/type/reference and partial failure.
Keep CSV10,000answers, complete definitions10,000, merged fields200, print33,554,432bytes and request1,048,576bytes. Do not introduce timing assertions into functional tests.

Adopt only candidates with measured user-visible or retained-memory benefit and full compatibility. If restoration overhead or memory worsens enough to cancel the benefit, retain the current JSON implementation and compare isolated backend copy removal next.
